name: agentbox
description: Claude Code plugins baked into the agentbox image; each is manifest-gated in agentbox.toml.

plugins.name: factrail
plugins.description: Jev compaction with fact rails: reduces what Jev lets go instead of deleting it, keeps the email taint fence, /factrail switch (ADR-2121). Baked from DreamLab-AI/factrail by lib/factrail.nix.

plugins.name: jev-checkpoints
plugins.description: Jev as the timing judge for the Opus advisor (ADR-2135, function hooks): done-without-verification, repeated-failure and plan checkpoints inject one advisory line; subagent model routing is shadow-only by default. Email taint fence, fail-open. /jev-checkpoints [status|on|off]. Authored in this repo; behind [features.jev_checkpoints].

plugins.name: ruflo-console
plugins.description: ruflo's cockpit inside Claude Code, including the ruRE page. Baked from ruvnet/ruflo main commit 631c155 behind [toolchains].ruflo_console; cli defaults to the baked ruflo 3.63.1 bin.

plugins.name: ruflo-mods
plugins.description: ruflo as a Claude Code mod (function hooks), including ruRE offer (off by default). Baked from ruvnet/ruflo main commit 631c155 behind [toolchains].ruflo_console; cli defaults to the baked ruflo 3.63.1 bin.

plugins.name: ruflo-swarm
plugins.description: Agent teams and swarm coordination with a live swarm pane (function hooks); answers /ruflo swarm pane|status|topology|claims|consensus. Baked from ruvnet/ruflo main commit 631c155 behind [toolchains].ruflo_console; cli defaults to the baked ruflo 3.63.1 bin.
